jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (f/m/d) located in Eindhoven & Dortmund (Software-Architect)
jobs.description:
Your mission Join Innolume

At Innolume, we develop innovative optoelectronic semiconductor technologies that power next-generation communication and sensing applications worldwide.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Software Engineer (f/m/d) who will work across our locations in Eindhoven and Dortmund and is comfortable traveling regularly between both sites.

In this role, you will modernize our software landscape, develop scalable applications, and connect software with laboratory and manufacturing equipment. Your work will directly support the development and production of cutting-edge photonic semiconductor devices while helping shape the next generation of our digital engineering environment.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and want to see your software making a tangible impact in a high-tech manufacturing environment, we would love to meet you.

Build the Software behind tomorrow's Semiconductor Technology:
• Design, develop and maintain software for automated measurement, equipment control and data acquisition
• Build scalable desktop applications and software architectures for engineering and manufacturing
• Modernise legacy software applications and migrate existing LabVIEW solutions to sustainable software platforms
• Integrate laboratory instruments, manufacturing equipment, databases, MES and ERP systems
• Develop reliable software interfaces and efficient data pipelines
• Improve software quality, maintainability and performance using modern engineering principles
• Troubleshoot complex software-hardware interactions in close collaboration with engineering teams
• Work closely with Production, Process Engineering, Quality and IT to deliver reliable software solutions
• Contribute to the digital transformation of semiconductor manufacturing

Your profile
• Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering or a related technical field
• Several years of professional software development experience
• Strong programming skills in Python and/or C# (C++ is an advantage)
• Solid understanding of software architecture, object-orientated programming and modern software engineering principles
• Experience developing desktop applications
• Experience with SQL databases and data management
• Familiarity with Git and collaborative software development workflows
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Fluent English language skills (spoken and written)

Nice to have
• German language skills are an advantage
• Experience with laboratory automation or industrial software
• Experience integrating laboratory instruments or manufacturing equipment
• Knowledge of MES, ERP or industrial communication interfaces
• Experience migrating legacy software systems
• Familiarity with Industry 4.0, process monitoring, or machine learning
• Experience in the semiconductor industry

Why us?What we offer:
• Exciting software projects in a highly innovative semiconductor environment
• The opportunity to shape a modern software platform with long-term impact
• An international, interdisciplinary team with flat hierarchies
• Short decision-making paths and a collaborative working culture
• Professional development and continuous learning opportunities
• Flexible working hours and an attractive compensation package

Join Innolume and help us develop the software that powers the next generation of photonic semiconductor technologies.
Career starters, graduates, and candidates with initial professional experience are encouraged to apply.?
We look forward to receiving your application.
Please send your complete application documents to jolanta.rzesa@innolume.com
Innolume GmbH
Konrad-Adenauer-Allee 11 | 44263 Dortmund
www.innolume.com

About usInnolume is an internationally operating specialist for GaAs-, InAs- & InP-based laser diodes. As part of our team you will be able to work on innovative projects from all over the world.
Our team of experts is always there to help you learn and hone your skills. We offer plenty of opportunities and room for personal and professional development.
We want to work in a motivating, social environment - which is why we take great care to provide it. A familial work culture and frequent team events are central to this.
Whether you are new to the field or an experienced employee: We are always searching for new talents to train and integrate into our team of experts. We offer full time positions as well as various internships.

Saarland University is a campus university with an international reputation for research excellence, particularly in computer science and in the life sciences and nanosciences. The university is also distinguished by its close ties to France and its strong European focus. Around 17,000 students, studying over one hundred different academic disciplines, are currently enrolled at Saarland University. Saarland University is officially recognized as one of Germany’s family-friendly higher-education institutions and with a combined workforce of more than 4000 it is one of the largest employers in the region.

The Centre for Language, Cognition and Computation (CLaCC) is inviting applications for the following position commencing the earliest possible time.

Academic research assistant (m/f/x)

Reference number W2904, salary in accordance with the German TV-L salary scale1, pay grade: E13 TV- L, duration of employment: until 31.12.2028, volume of employment: 100 % of standard working time.

Workplace/Department:

Text+ is a collaborative project funded under the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI; text-plus.org/). As part of Text+, you will be part of a geographically distributed network of research groups, focusing on the integration of large language models (LLMs) into data preparation and analysis in the field of Digital Humanities (DH). At Saarland University, you will be based at the Centre for Language, Cognition and Computation (ClaCC) and be part of Prof. E. Teich’s research group within the Department of Language Science and Technology (LST; www.uni-saarland.de/fachrichtung/lst.html).

Job requirements and responsibilities:

• Application and comparison of language models for specific digital humanities tasks (e.g. text annotation)

• Adaptation of language models to different registers/text types

• Evaluation of language models with regard to bias

• Development of LM-based processing pipelines for users in the humanities

• Publication record in relevant areas

Your academic qualifications:

• Completed university studies in computational linguistics, digital humanities or computer science

• Language skills (according to GER): Fluent in spoken and written German and English (C1)

The successful candidate will also be expected to:

• Have excellent knowledge of how to use large language models, particularly in the field of digital humanities

• Have solid programming skills, particularly in Python

• Have experience with relevant platforms, e.g. PyTorch, spaCy

• Have teamwork skills

•Language skills (according to GER): The working language of the Text+ Consortium is German, so a very good command of German is required. In addition, a very good command of English (C1) is required.

What we can offer you:

• A flexible work schedule allowing you to balance work and family, among other things the possibility of teleworking

• Secure and future-oriented employment with attractive conditions

• A broad range of further education and professional development programmes (for example language courses)

• An occupational health management model with numerous attractive options, such as our university sports programme

• Supplementary pension scheme (RZVK)

• Discounted tickets on local public transport services (‘Job-Ticket‘ of the saarVV)

We look forward to receiving your meaningful online application (in a PDF file) by 04.09.2026 to clacc@uni-saarland.de Please include the reference number W2904 in the subject line of the e-mail.

If you have any questions, please contact us for assistance. Your contact:

Frau Prof. Dr. Elke Teich.

FR LST, UdS campus, clacc@uni-saarland.de

Pay grade classification is based on the particular details of the position held and the extent to which the applicant meets the requirements of the pay grade within the TV-L salary scale. Part-time employment is generally possible.

If you have obtained a foreign university degree, a proof of the equivalence of this degree with a German degree by the Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen (ZAB) is needed before hiring. If necessary, please apply for this in time. You can find more information at https://www.kmk.org/zeugnisbewertung.

Unfortunately, neither costs for attending an interview at Saarland University nor costs for any certificate evaluation by the ZAB can be reimbursed in principle.

We welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, and sexual orientation and identity. In accordance with its policy of increasing the proportion of women, the University actively encourages applications from women. Applications from severely disabled persons will be given preferential consideration in the event of equal suitability.

When you submit a job application to Saarland University you will be transmitting personal data. Please refer to our privacy notice for information on how we collect and process personal data in accordance with Art. 13 of the Datenschutz-Grundverordnung. jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Computational Chemistry (f/m/d) (Pay scale 13 TV-L, 67 %) (Chemiker/in)
jobs.description:
We are a young, innovative university in the middle of the Metropole Ruhr. Excellent in research and teaching, we think in terms of possibilities instead of limits and develop ideas with a future. We live diversity, promote potential and are committed to educational equity.
The University of Duisburg-Essen invites applications for the position of a
PhD Student in Computational Chemistry (f/m/d) (Pay scale 13 TV-L, 67 %) (gross 38.265 – 54.388 €)
at the Faculty of Chemistry, Institute for Physical Chemistry (located at the campus in Essen).
The Faculty of Chemistry at the UDE is one of the largest chemistry faculties in Germany and offers three study programs under one roof: Chemistry, Water Science and Chemistry Teachers College. The young and dynamic research group led by Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt focuses on elucidating the structures and reactions of transition-metal enzymes with computer simulations, thereby bridging the fields of computational chemistry and quantum crystallography.

Your tasks

You will conduct research within the project “Boosting Enzymatic Plastic Recycling via Future Computing” as part of the NRW Return Programme of Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt. The main focus of your position will be on evaluating quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) calculations on metalloenzymes and exploring whether machine learning can be used for predictions of enzymatic reactions in biomass and plastic degradation. In these areas, you will closely collaborate with postdoctoral and PhD researchers who have experience in QM/MM calculations of metalloenzymes and machine learning. Additionally, you will contribute to supervising students, teaching activities, and administrative tasks, aligned with your transferable skill development.

Your profile

- By the time of appointment, you will have successfully completed your university studies in chemistry, biochemistry, cheminformatics, bioinformatics, biology, physics or a related field with a standard period of study of at least eight semesters (minimum 270 credit points or equivalent) and an average grade of at least ‘good’ (or equivalent)
- You are highly motivated to pursue research in sustainable chemistry and push the boundaries of computational biochemistry
- Ideally, you have first experience in QM calculations and their analysis. Experience with QM/MM or QM-cluster calculations on enzymes is desirable but not required; you are eager to learn these methods
- Previous experience in the use of machine learning and/or QM software packages, high-performance computing (HPC) clusters, and Linux operating systems will be considered an advantage
- You demonstrate scientific curiosity, take responsibility for your own work, and actively contribute to team-oriented, interdisciplinary, and international collaborations inside and outside the research group. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential
The position offers the opportunity for further scientific qualification.

We offer

- An interesting and responsible research position with broad opportunities for academic and personal growth, allowing you to take responsibility and establish valuable connections with academic and industrial collaborators locally as well as internationally
- A supportive and appreciative working atmosphere within a highly motivated, international and diverse research group. We look forward to welcoming and onboarding our new team member
- Fully funded participation in national and international workshops, summer schools, and conferences as well as dedicated presentation training
- Training in state-of-the-art computational methods and software (e.g., ORCA, AMBER) as well as access to significant HPC resources (e.g., the cluster AmplitUDE (https://escience-wissr.gitpages.uni-due.de/hpc-support/content/amplitUDE/amplitude_hardware.html) )
- Access to graduate courses, transferable skills training and the possibility to apply for the Water Graduate School (WGS (https://www.uni-due.de/zwu/wgs.php) )
- Family-friendly policies, including childcare support
- Advisory services for employees with family care responsibilities
- Possibility to enrol as a student, granting access to student housing, local public transport throughout Germany (Deutschlandsemesterticket (https://www.uni-due.de/faq-studium/semesterticket_en.php) ) and discounts at university canteens, museums, etc.
- Excellent public transport connections and free parking
- Access to attractive sports and health programs (university sports)
- The possibility of remote work
Starting date: 01.12.2026
Contract period: 36 months (3 years) with the possibility of extension
Working time: 67% of a full-time employment (part-time employment is possible)
Application deadline: 25.09.2026
Please submit your application (motivation letter, CV, diplomas, transcript of records with grades, at least two references) quoting reference 416-26 to: Prof. Dr. Erna K. Wieduwilt, Universität Duisburg-Essen, Fakultät für Chemie, Campus Essen, 45117 Essen. Please compile your application in a single PDF file and send it via email to applications.wieduwilt@uni-due.de.
Additional information about our research and group can be found at:
- About the project “Boosting Enzymatic Plastic Recycling via Future Computing”: https://www.uni-due.de/2025-12-08-professor-erna-wieduwilt-researches-plastic-recycling
- About the group: https://www.linkedin.com/posts/erna-wieduwilt_scienceisteamwork-chemistry-mint-activity-7482096217875857408-1d_R?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desk-top&rcm=ACoAADDOYrUBY5t0a3GvPalmhq6zjRkeWRjRhdk (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/erna-wieduwilt_scienceisteamwork-chemistry-mint-activity-7482096217875857408-1d_R?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desk-top&rcm=ACoAADDOYrUBY5t0a3GvPalmhq6zjRkeWRjRhdk)
- Current webpage: https://www.uni-due.de/zmb/members/erna-wieduwilt.php
The University of Duisburg-Essen is committed to promoting diversity among its members (see https://www.uni-due.de/diversity/en/). It aims to increase the number of women in academic positions and therefore explicitly encourages qualified women to apply. Women will be given preference in accordance with the North Rhine-Westphalia State Equality Act (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz NRW) if they have equivalent qualifications. Applications from suitable severely disabled persons and persons of equal status within the meaning of Section 2 (3) SGB IX are welcome.

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
Join our dynamic team at Boehringer Ingelheim as a Customer Experience (CX) Head, TA. In this pivotal role, you will be the strategic linchpin, leveraging data to enrich decision-making and uncovering new business opportunities within the TA. Working in close collaboration with the TA Head and a standing member of the Brand Team, you will drive customer-centric initiatives for Human Pharma Germany. If you're passionate about shaping customer experiences and have a knack for strategic thinking, we'd love to hear from you.
Tasks & responsibilities

- As the primary point of contact, you will engage with the TA Head and Brand Team, acting as a strategic sparring partner.
- You will be responsible for converting strategic and high-level tactical features into smaller, actionable user stories.
- Strong capabilities for business case and LRR development by evaluating on-going operational requirement against existing resource and capabilities
- Integral analytical support for OL, ACV and LTF planning process and preparations on a strategic level
- Involvement in business cases and LRR development will be a key part of your role, as you evaluate ongoing operational requirements against existing resources and capabilities.
- Overall management and leadership of 4-6 direct reports (incl people development) for the functional areas related to Project Management, Training & Development, Customer Insights & Forecasting, and Sales Force Effectiveness.
- Establishing strategic and cooperative relationships with various functions within HP Business Operations and cross-functional teams will be a major part of your role.
- You will serve as a liaison between various functions and groups (Brand Team, HP Operations Group Heads and Squad Leads), influencing stakeholders to improve productivity, manage necessary changes, and support key business projects.
- Direct reporting line to Head of Human Pharma Operations, Human Pharma Germany.

Requirements

- Doctoral degree (e.g., PhD, MD) and/or a Master's degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) or diploma degree
- Possess experience in a leadership or people manager role, including in-depth knowledge of the German human pharmaceutical market
- Exhibit excellent relationship-building skills and conflict management with above-average oral, written, and presentation skills
- Demonstrate the ability to drive change, manage organizational transformations, and proactively implement innovation
- Have experience in Commercial (Sales and/or Marketing), Training, Business Analyst roles.
- Possess the ability to lead and steer different functions and can lead without authority within a TAs
- Be capable of simplifying complex topics and providing clear actionable next steps.
- Exhibit strength in being a solution-driven leader to address issues/challenges and lead the team to move forward together
- Possess strong people management skills - inspires and develops growth for team members

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:

Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning of October

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

Join our Compression Regional Service Sales within Siemens Energy TI Compression as a Client Manager supporting customers from the Oil & Gas, chemical and industrial sectors.

The Client Manager is the owner of the client relationship, and is responsible for ensuring customer satisfaction, meeting client requirements and driving Services bookings growth within their respective territory. He/she leads all aspects of business and opportunity development from the initial stages through order entry. 

This position is primarily focused on Germany (Western & Eastern part) market and reports to the Head of Sales REGION WE, SWE, NORDICS and GERMANY.

You will be involved in some of the most exciting and challenging service and modernization projects within these industries. This is a highly networked role that requires an ability to work under challenging deadlines. 

 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and manage long-term relationships with assigned clients
* Proactively and systematically prospect the market aiming to generate new leads and opportunities.
* Understand the evaluation and decision-making process of customers and develop a strategy to position Siemens Energy ahead of the competition. 
* Develop and execute the sales capture plan (annual plan) and strategy around each customer in your responsibilities, incorporating the customer needs, equipment application, Siemens Energy strengths, competitor’s weaknesses and a robust market level pricing recommendation based on the assessment of competitive position.
* Identify advanced business opportunities (LMU) and support RPDM in developing and successfully closing such opportunities.

Location Alzey, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany Category Manufacturing/Quality Job Type Full Time  Regular Job Id R-97740

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. Site Microbiologist (Responsible Scientist) (m/w/d)

Interprets water system results from bioburden, endotoxin, and microbiological identity testing, and takes action based on the results to drive system and process improvement.
- **Environmental Monitoring: **Acts as the microbiological SME for environmental monitoring, including viable and non-viable sampling, in Grade A to Grade D areas across manufacturing and QC areas. Provides guidance on implementing environmental monitoring programs in accordance with regulatory requirements. Demonstrates an understanding of the overall contamination control strategy (CCS) for manufacturing and QC areas.
- **Sterilization / Depyrogenation Equipment and Cleaning Validation: **Understands manufacturing equipment and processes such as autoclaves, isolators, dry heat tunnels, and CIP/SIP processes. Has an in-depth understanding of the associated microbiological samples, such as biological indicators, endotoxin indicators, rinse samples, and swab samples. Demonstrates an understanding of testing and interpreting results.
- Audits: Acts as a front-room SME, discussing topics directly with regulatory bodies. Acts as a microbiology SME during audit tours and audit responses.
- Investigations: Leads GMP investigations, including OOS/OOT, deviations, and atypical results, using recognized root cause analysis methodologies such as 5-Why and Ishikawa/Fishbone. Draws sound technical conclusions and recommends corrective and preventive actions.
- **Projects / Workload Projections: **Acts as the QC Microbiology representative for the above-named topics and forecasts QC Microbiology workload.
- Performs technical review, interpretation, and release of raw material, in-process, and finished product data, and contributes to annual product reviews and process validations.
- Provides technical training and mentors analysts through a formal process. Contributes to the development and implementation of Global Lab Quality Standards.

How do you convince us?

- Education Level: Master’s degree or Bachelor’s degree in a science or engineering-related discipline, with extensive relevant work experience in topics/areas such as QC Laboratories, manufacturing areas, utility systems, environmental monitoring and method validation.
- Experience: 7–10 years of demonstrated relevant experience in a GMP Microbiology Laboratory, sterile manufacturing areas, and utility systems.
- Prior work across the full analytical method lifecycle (development, verification, transfer, validation, and remediation) for microbiological test methods (Bioburden, Endotoxin, Sterility)
- Fluent in English & good German

Additional Skills/ Preferences:

- Demonstrated strong problem-solving skills, with preferred training and proficiency in Root Cause Analysis methodology.
- Demonstrated strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with business partners and auditors.
- Proven ability to focus on continuous improvement.

jobs.occupation: Research Group Leader for the Research Area C: Power – Violence – Trauma (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Tasks

The University of Bonn is an international research university offering a broad range of subjects. With a 200-year history, some 31,500 students, more than 6,000 employees and an outstanding reputation in Germany and abroad, the University of Bonn is one of the leading universities in Germany and has been awarded the status of a University of Excellence.

The Bonn Center for Dependency and Slavery Studies (BCDSS) is looking to fill the following position with effect from 1 January 2027, on a fixed-term contract until 31 December 2032:

Research Group Leader for the Research Area C: Power – Violence – Trauma

The BCDSS, a German Research Council-funded “Cluster of Excellence”, offers excellent opportunities for inter-disciplinary and comparative research of different forms of Strong Asymmetrical Dependencies (SADs) across time periods and world regions. During its first phase (2019–2025), the BCDSS successfully developed the con-cept of SAD as a comprehensive analytical framework to understand how power imbalances have been shaped in the past, and continue to influence, societies around the world today. In its second funding phase (2026–2032), the BCDSS will investigate the underlying causes and mechanisms that contribute to the persistence of SADs across historical and contemporary contexts. We aim to anchor Historically Informed Dependency Studies (HIDS) as a key interdisciplinary field in the humanities, encouraging scholars across the humanities and social sciences to systematically integrate the analysis of SADs into the study of social, economic, and cultural phe-nomena.

Our research focuses on five Research Areas:

- Transitions and Transformations of SADs,
- Economies of SADs,
- Power – Violence – Trauma,
- Cultural Heritage – Transitional Justice – Memory Cultures,
- Alternative Archives and Life Writing.

The successful candidate will lead a Research Group in the BCDSS' Research Area C “Power – Violence – Trau-ma”, design and conduct independent projects in the field of Historically Informed Dependency Studies (HIDS) that closely relate to the Research Area's research goals. Topics can be of a wide variety – from micro studies to wide scale approaches, in any historical period or geographical region. A Research Group at the BCDSS is an independent research unit led by an early-career researcher to pursue an original research agenda while su-pervising a small team of researchers. The successful candidate will recruit two doctoral researchers for the research group and collaborate closely with colleagues from the BCDSS, in particular the cluster professor for Trauma Studies/ History of Violence. Furthermore, the successful candidate will be part of the interdisciplinary and international research community. 

Your tasks:

- Developing the research profile of the Research Group on the historical relation-ship between violence, trauma, and coercion within the field of Historically In-formed Dependency Studies (HIDS),
- Recruiting and supervising two doctoral researchers,
- Providing academic leadership and strategic development of the Research Group and Research Area C,
- Conducting an independent research project leading to a second monograph or equivalent work,
- Developing innovative theoretical and methodological approaches to analyse SAD,
- Organizing and contributing to international workshops, seminars, and confer-ences,
- Building national and international research networks.

Your profile

- At least three years of postdoctoral experience and an excellent academic track record in one or more of the following fields: the history of violence, trauma studies, historical psychology (excluding the history of psychoanalysis), or a related discipline represented at the BCDSS (e.g. Anthropology, Archaeology, Art History, History, Law, Regional Studies, Sociology, or Theology),
- Publications relevant to the BCDSS research agenda in general and Research Area C in particular,
- Native or near-native proficiency in English,
- A strong interest in advancing research on HIDS from a comparative and interdisciplinary perspective,
- Demonstrated ability to develop innovative research questions and engage with methodological and epistemological challenges,
- Experience in collaborative and interdisciplinary research.

Wir bieten

- The opportunity to establish and lead an independent Research Group, including the recruitment and supervision of two doctoral researchers,
- Membership in the interdisciplinary and international research environment of the Bonn Center for Dependency and Slavery Studies (BCDSS),
- An open, collaborative, and innovative research culture that encourages interdis-ciplinary exchange,
- Mentoring by two senior professors and comprehensive opportunities for profes-sional and leadership development,
- Excellent institutional support for independent research, career development, families, and equal opportunities,
- Many options available for university sports,
- Excellent access by public transport thanks to Bonn's central location as well as the opportunity to take advantage of low-cost parking,
- Flexible working hours and the ability to work from home,
- Remuneration in accordance with TV-L pay grade 14.

Your application needs to include:

- Cover letter stating your motivation to work at the BCDSS (max. 1800 characters including spaces),
- Curriculum Vitae,
- A copy of your PhD certificate,
- An outline of the proposed Research Group (max. 10.000 characters including spaces). Please include information on:
- Key research questions and hypotheses;
- originality of the proposed project vis-à-vis existing scholarship and key publications in the field (with bibliography),
- alignment of the project with the BCDSS' research goals in general,
- relevance of the project to Research Area C in particular and, if applicable, cross-connections to other Research Areas,
- concise ideas for two PhD projects,
- The name and contact of two referees (position, professional address, and e-mail).

The University of Bonn promotes an open, respectful, and non-discriminatory academic culture and is actively committed to equal opportunity and family friendliness. We aim to eliminate structural disadvantages and to strengthen diversity in research, teaching, and administration. Therefore, we welcome all applications, regardless of ethnic or social background, gender, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, or age.

Applications from women and people with a documented severe disability (or equivalent status) will be given preferential consideration in accordance with the State Equality Act (LGG) NRW and Social Code (SGB) IX.

If you are interested in this position, please send your complete application to application@dependency.uni-bonn.de by September 15, 2026, quoting reference 2026/387. For technical reasons, applications may only be submitted by email as a single PDF file. Please do not hesitate to contact BCDSS Managing Director Jeannine Bischoff (dependency@uni-bonn.de) if you need any more information.

- Experience in collaborative and interdisciplinary research.

Wir bieten
